newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-VICENZA WASTE HISTORIC CHANCE TO GO TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VICENZA WASTE HISTORIC CHANCE TO GO TOP.

text.p: Unfashionable Vicenza wasted a historic chance to go top of Serie A on Sunday when they could only draw 2-2 at lowly Verona to remain a point behind Italian leaders Internazionale.
Vicenza, who have never solely led in Serie A, would have leapfrogged Inter at the top with a victory after the Milan club were held to a 2-2 home draw by Fiorentina on Saturday.
But Francesco Guidolin's side were lucky to come away with a point after letting in two early goals against their northeastern Veneto rivals in a hard-fought derby.

Bologna, meanwhile, knocked European champions Juventus out of third spot as Swedish and Russian internationals Kennet Andersson and Igor Kolyvanov both scored in a 3-1 comeback victory against bottom club Reggiana.
Juventus can reach Inter on 18 points but will need to beat fellow giants AC Milan in their home match later on Sunday.
At Genoa, Italy striker Enrico Chiesa's late equaliser gave Parma a 1-1 draw over Sampdoria in his first match against his former club, who sold him last May.

Giuseppe Signori pulled off a hat-trick in Lazio's 3-1 win at Piacenza while in-form Alfredo Aglietti struck twice in Napoli's thrilling 4-2 home victory over Perugia. Napoli are now level on points with Juventus.
